title: GrowMate
summary: My own privacy-first finance tracker: income, investments, goals and net worth, in the cloud or as a desktop app.
problem: Most people track money across bank apps, notebooks and spreadsheets, and never see the full picture: what comes in, where it goes, what they owe, what they own and whether their goals are on track.
solution: GrowMate is the privacy-first alternative to spreadsheets. It tracks income with planned allocations, expenses, assets, debts, investments, insurance and goals, with net worth over time. Use it in the browser, or download the desktop app for Windows, macOS or Linux and keep every number on your own machine. Both are free.

features.title: Income and allocation
features.description: Split each income into savings, spending and goals as it arrives.

features.title: Expenses and debts
features.description: Track spending by type and loans until they are cleared.

features.title: Investments and assets
features.description: Holdings and their value over time.

features.title: Goals
features.description: Set a target and see progress month by month.

features.title: Insurance
features.description: Policies and premium dates in one list.

features.title: Net worth
features.description: Regular snapshots show the whole picture moving.

features.title: Cloud or desktop
features.description: Use it in the browser, or offline on Windows, macOS and Linux with automatic updates.
